summary: Iter92 Safety Pathway Engine E2E — ran all 11 backend scenarios (steps 1-9) via pytest and 4 UI scenarios (steps 10-13) via Playwright. All passed. Pathway engine routes, decision workflow (dismiss/confirm/change), highest-wins across parents, parent/professional access boundaries, access-event logging, sanitized Legal Lens block + PDF, Parent screening page with Quick Exit (click + Escape twice) and storage sanitization, Professional pathway decision panel, and LegalLensReport pathway block all behave per spec.
critical_code_review_comments: safety_screening.item_view (line 145) uses a complex boolean expression without parentheses — relies on Python precedence (`and` binds tighter than `or`). Works, but adding explicit parens would make the flag logic easier to audit.

safety_pathway.public_pathway (line 120): the 'order' flag only looks at screenings for roles whose pathway is CONFIRMED. If a parent reports an active protective order (x_5=Yes) but the pro has not yet confirmed that parent's pathway (dismissed), the court_order_notice is suppressed in the report. This matches spec (nothing shows until pro confirms), but worth documenting.
